email.subject: Quick note on Northwind Group Plumbing's site
email.body:
Hi Hannah,

I looked at Northwind Group Plumbing's site. Two things are likely costing you calls: it doesn't display properly on mobile, and the page title is weak, so you're probably getting buried under other Harbor Falls plumbers in search results. On top of that, the images are slow to load, which pushes impatient visitors away before they even see your number.

I fix exactly this kind of thing for a flat fee. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough where I show you what's happening and what I'd do first?

Alex
Northlight Web
